arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tests/t_lifecycle.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from harness import *

failures=[]
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        failures.append(name); print('FAIL',name); print('  got ',json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True)[:500]); print('  want',json.dumps(want,sort_keys=True)[:500])
    else: print('ok  ',name)

def base(**kw):
    doc={"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
    doc.update(kw); return doc
EXPECT={"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}

frames=[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}]
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":frames,"expect":EXPECT}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
sent = action(0,0,'H',[(':method',b'GET'),(':authority',b'h'),(':path',b'/')], False)
check('timeout', (c['state'],c['at'],c['frames'],c['request_frames'],c['sent'],c['received'],
                  c['response_frames'],c['response_body'],c['payload_bytes'],c['flags'],c['origin_count']),
      ('timeout',10,1,1,fp(sent),fp(b''),0,fp(b''),3+1+1+1+4+1+1,['missing_origin'],0))

doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":frames,"expect":EXPECT}],events=[{"at":3,"kind":"close"}])
check('closed', (lambda c:(c['state'],c['at']))(run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]), ('closed',3))

frames2=[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]},
         {"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":7},
         {"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"body","End_Stream":True}]
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":frames2,"expect":EXPECT}],events=[{"at":3,"kind":"close"}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('paused close', (c['state'],c['at'],c['frames'],c['request_frames'],c['sent'],c['payload_bytes']),
      ('closed',3,1,1,fp(action(0,0,'H',[(':method',b'GET'),(':authority',b'h'),(':path',b'/')],False)),27))

doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}],"expect":EXPECT}],
           events=[{"at":1,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[[":status","204"]],"end":True},
                   {"at":9,"kind":"close"}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('ok then close', (c['state'],c['at'],c['response_frames'],c['received']), ('ok',1,1,fp(action(1,0,'h',[(b':status',b'204')],True))))

frames3=[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]},
         {"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"late"}]
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":frames3,"expect":EXPECT}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
exp = action(0,0,'H',[(':method',b'GET'),(':authority',b'h'),(':path',b'/')],True)
check('send_error', (c['state'],c['at'],c['frames'],c['sent'],c['flags']), ('send_error',0,1,fp(exp),['missing_origin']))

frames4=[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]},
         {"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":4}]
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":frames4,"expect":EXPECT}],
           events=[{"at":4,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True}])
check('sleep after end', (lambda c:(c['state'],c['at'],c['frames']))(run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]), ('ok',4,1))

frames5=[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]},
         {"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":5},
         {"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"x","End_Stream":True}]
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":frames5,"expect":EXPECT}],
           events=[{"at":2,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":"resp","end":True}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('retain while sending', (c['state'],c['at'],c['sent'],c['received'],c['response_body']),
      ('ok',5,fp(action(0,0,'H',[(':method',b'GET'),(':authority',b'h'),(':path',b'/')],False)+action(5,0,'D',b'x',True)),
       fp(action(2,0,'d',b'resp',True)),fp(b'resp')))

doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"datagram","data_to_transfered":"dg","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}],
           events=[{"at":1,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":"a","data":"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n\r\n"}]}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('datagram', (c['state'],c['at'],c['frames'],c['request_frames'],c['sent'],c['flags']),
      ('ok',1,1,0,fp(action(0,0,'G',b'dg',False)),['unsent_origin']))

doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}],"expect":EXPECT}],
           events=[{"at":1,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True},
                   {"at":2,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":"nope","end":True},
                   {"at":3,"kind":"headers","stream":99,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True},
                   {"at":4,"kind":"data","stream":8,"data":"alsonope","end":True}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('ignore later', (c['state'],c['at'],c['response_frames'],c['received']), ('ok',1,1,fp(action(1,0,'h',[(b':status',b'200')],True))))

doc = base(timeout_ms=5,
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}],"expect":EXPECT},
                  {"name":"b","frames":[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}],"expect":EXPECT}],
           events=[{"at":5,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True}])
cs = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases']
check('tie wins', (cs[0]['state'],cs[0]['at']), ('ok',5))
check('other times out', (cs[1]['state'],cs[1]['at']), ('timeout',5))
check('stream ids', [c['stream'] for c in cs], [0,4])

doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]},
                                        {"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":2}],"expect":EXPECT}],
           events=[{"at":2,"kind":"close"}])
check('zero pause yields', (lambda c:(c['state'],c['at']))(run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]), ('closed',2))

# random token inside an expression string literal stays literal data
doc = base(definitions=[["d","b'x<<random_string>>y'"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{d}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
check('token in expr literal', run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]['sent'], fp(action(0,0,'D',b'x<<random_string>>y',True)))
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{ <<random_string>> }}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
check('token alone invalid', run(json.dumps(doc)), {"error":"input"})

# datagram after request end
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]},
                                        {"Type":"datagram","data_to_transfered":"g"}],"expect":EXPECT}])
c=run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('datagram after end', (c['state'],c['at'],c['sent']), ('send_error',0,
      fp(action(0,0,'H',[(':method',b'GET'),(':authority',b'h'),(':path',b'/')],True))))

# empty case times out
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":EXPECT}])
check('empty case timeout', (lambda c:(c['state'],c['at'],c['frames']))(run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]), ('timeout',10,0))

# close at time 0 after all case starts
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":EXPECT},{"name":"b","frames":[],"expect":EXPECT}],
           events=[{"at":0,"kind":"close"}])
check('close at zero', [(c['state'],c['at']) for c in run(json.dumps(doc))['cases']], [('closed',0),('closed',0)])

# pause completion vs close at the same time: close first
doc = base(timeout_ms=100,
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":3},{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"A","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT},
                  {"name":"b","frames":[{"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":3},{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"B","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}],
           events=[{"at":3,"kind":"close"}])
check('pause vs close order', [(c['state'],c['frames']) for c in run(json.dumps(doc))['cases']], [('closed',0),('closed',0)])

# events at equal time in input order
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":2},{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"A","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}],
           events=[{"at":2,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":False},
                   {"at":2,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":"ok","end":True},
                   {"at":2,"kind":"close"}])
c=run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('event order at tie', (c['state'],c['at'],c['response_frames'],c['response_body'],c['received']),
      ('closed',2,2,fp(b'ok'),fp(action(2,0,'h',[(b':status',b'200')],False)+action(2,0,'d',b'ok',True))))

# response events retained while paused
doc = base(timeout_ms=50,cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":5},{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"A","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}],
           events=[{"at":1,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True}])
check('retained while paused', (lambda c:(c['state'],c['at'],c['response_frames']))(run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]), ('ok',5,1))

print('FAILURES:', len(failures))
PYEOF
cd /workspace/project && python3 /workspace/tests/t_lifecycle.py 2>&1 | grep -vE "^ok " | head -30
